description: The nth Jacobsthal number. J0 is 0, J1 is 1, and each later term is the previous one plus twice the one before that. An optional modulus reduces the term, and zero is rejected. n runs from 0 to 8192. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/jacobsthal
